confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live menus, listings, or booking pages were inspected. Food and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is less certain given wide property variation and summer peak demand. Cocktail and wine were set from typical multiples of the beer anchor (about 4.5x and 5x) because direct bar-price knowledge is limited. The FX value comes from web search summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian coastal resort basis, drawn from general knowledge of Vietnamese beach-resort cities such as Da Nang and Phan Thiet and adjusted to Nha Trang's own tourist price levels; no specific comparable listing or dataset was used.
